_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. xpFactor 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Recover and SummonTotem. Shares the Hermit sprite (entityType override). ⚑ QUESTS: the SHAMAN leg of D9's branch — `wolves-on-the-road` carry_word → told_shaman, rewarding Slow + 400 XP. The CityGuard carries the other leg. He stands by the road at (18, 6), most of the map short of the city gate — that distance IS the trade the crier names. ⚑ TEXT SHAPE (PO 2026-08-02, on top of the Q4/R1 tree shape): quest and teach text is deliberately plain — no lore or stylized wording yet. The turn-in is a row directly at root (the quest is not his, so there is no quest node; the Q1 show-rule keeps the row invisible except at carry_word); teachings behind a 'Teach me something.' row as rows that NAME the skill directly. Since plan-generic-kill-quests.md C2 he also OFFERS and turns in `dire-wolves-at-the-camp` behind its own root row — giver and foreign-turn-in coexist on one root.
